The '''Clan Amersu''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] family on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. In [[Twi'leki/Legends|Ryl]], the native [[Language/Legends|language]] of the Twi'leks, the name Amersu derived from an adjective meaning "solid." Among the members of this clan was the blue-skinned [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Xiaan Amersu]], who fought during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
